title: BioPilot Catalog: one tool
description: Format of knowledge/tools/<tool>.yml. `npm run build:db` validates every file against this schema, then runs the cross-file checks (duplicate tools, duplicate aliases, version regex).

name.description: Executable name, as typed in the shell (e.g. fastp, porechop, blastn).

package.description: Conda package, when it differs from the executable name.

description.description: Short description, in our own words (never copied from --help).

platforms.description: Sequencing platforms the tool serves; omit or leave empty for a generic tool.

args.description: Arguments that make the tool print its version, e.g. ["--version"].

regex.description: JavaScript regular expression with exactly one capture group: the version number.

help.description: Arguments that make the tool print its help, e.g. ["--help"].

arguments.description: Positional arguments of the root command.

args.description: Arguments to pass; an empty list runs the tool bare (bwa prints its help and version that way).

names.description: Every alias of the option (case-sensitive). The first long name is the canonical name.

rank.description: 90–100 main inputs/outputs and reference; 70–89 very common; 50 default; 30–49 fine tuning; 10–29 rare, debug or deprecated.

since.description: First tool version that has the option, when known.

until.description: Last tool version that has the option, when known.

hidden.description: Known (for parsing a command line) but never suggested.

deprecated.description: Still accepted but obsolete; give it a low rank.

threads.description: type int: the number of threads (or CPUs, cores, workers) the command uses; biopilot check compares it with the CPUs available.

when.description: Context condition; every field given must hold. An empty condition always holds.

used.description: Aliases of options of the same command that are already on the command line.

paired.description: The project has complete read pairs (true) or none (false).

platform.description: Holds when the project's platforms contain this one.

boost.description: Added to the rank when the condition holds; −100 to +100.

commands.description: Subcommands, in the order the tool lists them.

name.description: Subcommand name as typed after its parent (e.g. sort for `samtools sort`).

help.description: Arguments that make the tool print this subcommand's help, e.g. ["sort", "--help"].

variadic.description: Takes one or more values; only the last argument may be variadic.

since.description: First tool version that has the option, when known.

until.description: Last tool version that has the option, when known.

type.description: int, float, string, file, dir or enum. Only enum restricts the value to `values`.

format.description: type file or dir: one or several formats declared in knowledge/formats.yml (fastq, [bam, sam], bwa-index…), most common first.

multiple.description: Takes several values after the option.

values.description: Suggested values; for type enum, the only allowed ones.

io.description: type file or dir: whether the command reads (input) or writes (output) it; biopilot check warns about a missing input or output folder. A derived output is an output. Omit when it depends on the mode.

read_role.description: type file: read 1 or read 2 of a read pair.

mate_of.description: Name of the mate argument (same command), which has the other read role.

from.description: Alias of the option whose value this output is derived from.

suffix.description: Added before the extensions, e.g. .trimmed → ctrl_R1.trimmed.fastq.gz.

derive.description: type file: output name derived from another option's value.

optionValue.description: What the option takes. Omit for a flag.
